name: Booking Check-In and Check-Out Date Chronology Validation
description: Reservation check-out date must be chronologically after the check-in date; past dates are disallowed.
preconditions: Booking search or reservation view active
invariants: Check-out date earlier than or equal to check-in date must be rejected
Selecting invalid date range shows calendar boundary warning

scenario_templates.title: Select Valid Reservation Date Range
scenario_templates.objective: Verify selecting future check-in and check-out dates progresses to room availability.

negative_scenarios.title: Check-out Before Check-in Date Boundary
negative_scenarios.objective: Verify error banner when check-out date is earlier than check-in date.
negative_scenarios.expected_error_message_fragment: Check-out date must be after check-in date

domain_assumptions: Selector hints, routes, option values and expected texts in this template were authored against one reference application (SauceDemo-style e-commerce). They are hypotheses: the planner uses a step or expectation only when it is observed on the current target.
